subject: Muthrive - deployment ownership & acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@muthrive.com>, procurement@muthrive.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Muthrive - deployment ownership & acceptance criteria

Hi Laura / Tessa,

Congrats to the team — Muthrive signed last week. Quick context so CS can pick up ownership:
- Account: Muthrive (Health data orchestration)
- Committed go-live: 2027-05-14 (pilot -> staged rollout)
- Environment: Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs), US-only data residency
- Key success metrics: 95th pctl latency < 300ms in steady-state, avg token cost target <= $0.002/token for production traffic, embeddings batch throughput ~120 req/s
- Compliance: Customer requires SOC 2 attestation and quarterly audit logs export (see SOW)

Attached: Muthrive_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW + acceptance criteria) and deployment_runbook.xlsx (draft). Procurement had a few billing/invoice sync Qs (procurement_questions.docx).

Asks:
1) Please nominate the CS owner and the implementation PM (we recommend Monica for technical onboarding and Tessa as Success lead).
2) Confirm a 60-90 minute kickoff in the week of 2027-04-04 to review runbook and acceptance tests.
3) Flag any immediate blockers (network/VPC peering, KMS/HSM requirements, or additional security questionnaires).

I'll remain on-thread for the next two weeks to help close outstanding items and hand over deliverables.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if it helps align owners sooner.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@muthrive.com>, procurement@muthrive.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Muthrive - deployment ownership & acceptance criteria

Thanks Karthik — and congrats, team.

Laura here (post-sign CS lead). Quick take and proposed owner assignments:
- CS Lead (customer-facing): Tessa Morgan — will run success plan, cadence, and adoption milestones.
- Implementation PM / Tech Onboard: Monica Patel — will own runbook execution, infra prep, and config.
- Primary contact for escalation/exec: me (Laura Bennett) — will handle SLA exceptions and exec syncs.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2027-04-05 10:00–11:30 PT. If that works for Muthrive, we'll send a calendar invite with pre-reads (SOW + runbook + acceptance checklist).

Pre-kickoff asks for the customer (quick triage before meeting):
- Confirm network topology & whether they will provide a dedicated VPC or want Redwood to provision peering.
- KMS provider preference (AWS KMS vs customer-managed HSM).
- A list of 2-3 technical stakeholders who will join the kickoff (names + emails).

I'll attach a trimmed onboarding checklist for the team to review. Monica/Tessa — please confirm you accept these owners and call out any resource conflicts.

Onward —
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0122

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Muthrive - deployment ownership & acceptance criteria

Hi Laura / Karthik — thanks and congrats on getting us live with Redwood. A few quick notes from the Muthrive side: 

1) Kickoff: 2027-04-05 10:00 PT works for our core team — please send invite and dial-in.
2) Tech stakeholders joining: Ravi Desai (Engineering Manager, ravi.desai@muthrive.com), Priya Mehta (SRE, priya.mehta@muthrive.com).
3) VPC: we will provide a dedicated VPC; Ravi will share topology and peering contact.
4) KMS: prefer customer-managed AWS KMS (we can't use vendor KMS for PHI in our phase 1).
5) Procurement question: our billing team asked whether Redwood can provide invoice line items that match our purchase order code (PO-2027-MUTH-09) and whether we can enable ACH rather than wire. I attached procurement_questions.docx with specifics.

DocuSign: procurement requested the executed contract copy — I see a link in the HubSpot record but can you confirm the signed PDF?

We are excited to get started.

— Aisha
Aisha Khan
Director of Product Operations, Muthrive
aisha.khan@muthrive.com

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the quick reply and the stakeholder names. A couple of follow-ups from Sales side:
- Confirmed go-live target remains 2027-05-14. That's our customer-committed date in the deal.
- Deal entitlements / credits: see attached redwood-entitlements-summary.pdf (limits on burst capacity included in Dedicated plan).

I'll drop the HubSpot deal link in this thread for Monica/Tessa to reference the milestone plan and MSA.

All — scheduling note + pre-kick checklist.

1) Calendar invite: Tue 2027-04-05 10:00–11:30 PT (invite sent). Please accept.
2) Pre-reads attached in Drive: SOW (final), deployment runbook (v1.2), acceptance test checklist. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-muthrive-kickoff
3) Action items before kickoff (owners):
   - Monica: validate that the Dedicated pool config meets requested throughput (due 2027-03-30).
   - Ravi (Muthrive): share network topology + peering contact (due 2027-03-28).
   - Procurement (Muthrive): confirm ACH vs wire and confirm invoice line mapping (due 2027-03-24).
   - Tessa: prepare success plan draft and initial milestone timeline (due 2027-03-31).

4) Risk flags: customer-managed KMS for PHI requires an attestation step; Monica, please check whether our provisioning steps need an addendum.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to kickoff. I'll run the meeting and share minutes + action register afterwards.

— Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
